questions.label: Hello Geo-observer. Mbarara University of Science and Technology being represented by UCoBs Sub project 1 is conducting a study in partnership with Uganda Wildlife Authority and the local communities (represented by citizen scientists/ Geo-Observers) around National Parks. This questionnaire is among the tools to guide this study and has been developed to guide in understanding the interactions between the communities around Lake Mburo and Bwindi Impenetrable National Parks. The study is aimed at understanding human wildlife conflicts and how these conflicts influence the livelihood of the local communities around the parks. At the end, this understanding shall guide the engagement of various stake holders to address the effects for peaceful and less threatened survival of the people around the selected national parks. Thank you for your participation and a Geo-observer.
